label: holds her retirement in his ledger
notes: Vask keeps the book that decides which caravans exist next season, and Ysoly is one crossing short of the retirement the Assembly owes her. He never has to threaten her; he only has to not finish a sentence. From chapter 3 on, every choice she makes is costed against a roof that does not move, and he is the man who can price it out from under her without raising his voice.
